dedupe_keys.name: gmp lifepo4 3 000 cycle synthetic degradation benchmark

description: The public Mendeley version 2 release provides 3,000 sequential charge-discharge cycle records for a nominal 25.6-volt, 40-ampere-hour LiFePO₄ pack associated with GMP Lithium in Bangladesh. A CSV, codebook, specification and permission documents are listed under CC BY 4.0. Fields include capacity, state of health, remaining useful life, pack current, temperature and eight individual cell voltages. The describing article is explicit that capacity follows a deterministic degradation curve calibrated to manufacturer ageing endpoints, while most cycle-level operating values were generated within specifications. It is not a raw continuous BMS log or a measured 3,000-cycle field history, despite the shorter repository description. This synthetic benchmark can test battery-health or prognostics code, but its construction limits claims about physical failure rates or fleet performance. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is comparing state-estimation algorithms under a controlled ageing trajectory. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related storage simulation environment; no integration was tested. The CSV and documentation were not downloaded or executed. Coverage is one nominal battery pack under a constructed cycle sequence, not a fleet sample.
